_comment: Which Azure services this skill builds a SKU catalog for.
Set "enabled": true to include a service, false to leave it out. Everything
else in the skill follows this file: only enabled services are fetched, only
they appear in the table, and verification checks exactly this set.
A one-off run can override the file without editing it:
The disabled entries below are fully implemented and verified - flip the flag
to turn one on. To add a service that is not listed at all, see SKILL.md.

services.note: Delegated to the sibling CurrentAzureSQLSKUInfo skill; per service-level objective.
Per tier. Every tier is on a retirement path; see SKILL.md.
Per size family, not per size - Azure documents ~800 sizes and the authoritative per-size list is the Resource SKUs API.
